transcript.text: I am on 96th and 2nd ave, and need to get to FiDi in 2 hours. I am a big fan of the band The Strokes. Help plan a trip to get there

A lost master recording from the early days of Lower East Side rock has surfaced, and an anonymous tipster sounding remarkably like Julian Casablancas needs your help tracking down the missing tape before it falls into the wrong hands. 

This adventure features 1 stop along the way, takes about 1 hour and 45 minutes total, and gets you to the Financial District right before your 2-hour deadline. (Note: Due to route timing constraints with your 2-hour window, we couldn't squeeze in an extra transit leg or a second stop, so this streamlined route keeps you on track.)

Your first destination is the historic **Germania Bank Building** at 190 Bowery and Spring Street [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germania_Bank_Building_(New_York_City)).

Are you ready to begin?
I have made it to the bank building

Welcome to the Germania Bank Building at 190 Bowery and Spring Street! Originally constructed in 1898–99 [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germania_Bank_Building_(New_York_City)), this striking landmark was designed by architect Robert Maynicke [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germania_Bank_Building_(New_York_City)). 

Your contact suspects a drop was made near this historic stone corner. Describe one visible feature of the stonework, arches, or architecture you notice here.

Spot on. That classic urban grit marks the spot. 

Your radio crackles to life: *A scrambled transmission from a vintage receiver comes through—Julian Casablancas left clues scattered across downtown rock history, and unlocking this old Bowery bank gives you the final combination code needed to secure the master tape.*

Now it's time for the final leg of your mission. Head south toward the Financial District to rendezvous with Julian's contact. 

**Directions:**
Walk roughly 28 minutes southwest from Spring Street down toward the Financial District. 

Let me know as soon as you have arrived in FiDi!

**Mission Accomplished!**

You successfully rendezvous with Julian's mysterious contact in the Financial District, hand over the recovered audio artifacts, and use the combination code unlocked from the old Bowery bank to secure the lost master tapes just in time.

### **Case File**
* **Stops Visited:** 
  1. **Germania Bank Building** (190 Bowery)
* **Real Facts Learned:**
  * The Germania Bank Building was designed by the German-born architect Robert Maynicke in a Renaissance Revival or Beaux-Arts style and built in 1898–99 [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germania_Bank_Building_(New_York_City)).
  * It became a New York City designated landmark on March 29, 2005 [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germania_Bank_Building_(New_York_City)).
* **Your Observation:** Spotted gritty downtown street art ("ugly kids") right on the historic stone facade.
* **Solution:** Recovered the lost audio files by piecing together downtown's legendary music and architectural history from the Bowery down to the Financial District.

Great work on tracking down rock history across Manhattan!
